runs.purpose: neorv32_twi is a TWI/I2C controller: it accepts bus requests (bus_req_i), implements control and status registers, a TX/RX FIFO pair, a clock/phase generator, and a bit-level TWI engine that drives/reads the SDA and SCL pins and raises irq_o. It exposes register readback and an interrupt to the bus via bus_rsp_o and irq_o.

clock generation (clk_gen.cnt, clk_gen.tick, phase generator) and the twi_engine state machine that sequences SDA/SCL phases and shifts bits (engine.sreg, engine.bitcnt, engine.state)
bus reads return control/status fields and RX FIFO word (bus_rsp_o.data carrying ctrl fields or fifo.rx_rdata)
interrupt reporting: irq_o is driven from ctrl.enable, fifo.tx_avail and engine.busy
reset clears control and engine registers and IO sample registers under rstn_i
